items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: With Stan Kenton you know I was with the mellophone band and playing lead trumpet with four mellophones, five trumpets and five trombones is kind of a chore.

ctx.x: But that didn’t matter at that point.

No it didn’t matter at all. But I say like watching those guys get on the band bus I said oh man I’ve got to do that someday. And I got to do it and then that’s the hardest part of the job is that band bus you know. With Stan Kenton you know I was with the mellophone band and playing lead trumpet with four mellophones, five trumpets and five trombones is kind of a chore. But it was a fun chore. But jeez, the bus, you know we had such a large band with Stan Kenton that we couldn’t check in every night you know. We…
Why did Stan keep the buses cold?
